title: Checks for usage of items through absolute paths, like std::f64::consts::PI.
summary: Many codebases have their own style when it comes to importing, but one that is seldom used is using absolute paths everywhere. This is generally considered unidiomatic, and you should add a use statement. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for comparisons where one side of the relation is either the minimum or maximum value for its type and warns if it involves a case that is always true or always false.
summary: Only integer and boolean types are checked. An expression like min <= x may misleadingly imply that it is possible for x to be less than the minimum. Expressions like max < x are probably mistakes. Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.
